en.t: Alexander the Great is crowned pharaoh of Egypt
en.s: Alexander III of Macedon (Ancient Greek: Ἀλέξανδρος, romanized: Aléxandros; 20/21 July 356 BC – 10/11 June 323 BC), most commonly known as Alexander the Great, was king of the ancient Greek kingdom of Macedon from 336 BC until his death. He was the son of Philip II, born to him by his fourth wife, Olympias, and ascended to the throne at the age of 20 after Philip was assassinated.

zh.t: 亚历山大大帝加冕为埃及法老
zh.s: 马其顿的亚历山大三世（古希腊语：Ἀλέξανδρος，转写：Aléxandros；公元前356年7月20日或21日—公元前323年6月10日或11日），通常称为亚历山大大帝，是古希腊马其顿王国国王，公元前336年即位至去世。他是腓力二世与第四任妻子奥林匹娅丝之子；腓力遇刺后，20岁的亚历山大继承王位。

en.s: The siege of Baghdad (Persian: محاصره بغداد) was the second attempt of the Ottoman Empire to recapture Baghdad. The Ottoman army under the command of Gazi Hüsrev Pasha besieged Baghdad, which had fallen to Iran in 1623, for the second time after the unsuccessful siege in 1625-26, but could not recapture it after a 39-day siege.

en.s: The Battle of Nyborg was a battle fought between Sweden and the combined forces of Denmark, Dutch naval forces under Michiel de Ruyter, troops of Brandenburg-Prussia, and Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth forces under Stefan Czarniecki. The battle was engaged on 14 November 1659 at Nyborg on the Danish island of Funen. Nyborg was the final major conflict of the Dano-Swedish War of 1658 to 1660. Swedish Imperial Field Marshal Philip Florinus of Sulzbach, leading the vanquished Swedish forces, was forced to save his own life by fleeing under cover of night. The battle is considered one of the most important Danish victories of the war.

zh.s: 1659年11月14日，瑞典军队在丹麦菲英岛的尼堡与多国联军交战。联军由丹麦军队、米歇尔·德·鲁伊特率领的荷兰海军、勃兰登堡—普鲁士军队，以及斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基率领的波兰—立陶宛联邦军队组成。尼堡战役是1658年至1660年丹麦—瑞典战争中最后一场重大冲突。瑞典军队战败，菲利普·弗洛里努斯·冯·苏尔茨巴赫元帅夜间逃跑保命。这场战役被视为丹麦在战争中最重要的胜利之一。

en.t: German astronomer Gottfried Kirch discovers the Great Comet of 1680, the first comet to be discovered by telescope
en.s: C/1680 V1, also called the Great Comet of 1680, Kirch's Comet, and Newton's Comet, was the first comet discovered by telescope. It was discovered by Gottfried Kirch and was one of the brightest comets of the seventeenth century. It passed about 235000 km from the surface of the Sun.

zh.s: 1680年11月14日，德国天文学家戈特弗里德·基希发现了1680年大彗星。这是第一颗通过望远镜发现的彗星，也是17世纪最明亮的彗星之一；它后来从距太阳表面约23.5万公里处掠过。

en.s: The Battle of Preston (9–14 November 1715) was the final action of the Jacobite rising of 1715, an attempt to put James Francis Edward Stuart on the British throne in place of George I. After two days of street-fighting, the Jacobite commander Thomas Forster surrendered to government troops under General Charles Wills. It was arguably the last battle fought on English soil.

zh.s: 1715年11月9日至14日的普雷斯顿战役是1715年詹姆斯党起义的最后一场军事行动。起义试图让詹姆斯·弗朗西斯·爱德华·斯图亚特取代乔治一世登上英国王位。街头交战两天后，詹姆斯党指挥官托马斯·福斯特向查尔斯·威尔斯将军率领的政府军投降。这可能是英格兰本土发生的最后一场战役。

en.s: The siege of Arcot (23 September – 14 November 1751) took place at Arcot, India between forces of the British East India Company led by Robert Clive allied with Muhammad Ali Khan Wallajah and forces of Nawab of the Carnatic, Chanda Sahib, allied with the French East India Company. It was part of the Second Carnatic War.

en.t: James Bruce discovers what he believes to be the source of the Nile
en.s: James Bruce of Kinnaird (14 December 1730 – 27 April 1794) was a Scottish traveller and travel writer who physically confirmed the source of the Blue Nile. He spent more than a dozen years in North and East Africa and in 1770 became the first European to trace and document the course of the Nile by following it upstream from Egypt through Sudan to its origins in the Blue Nile in Ethiopia.

zh.t: 詹姆斯·布鲁斯发现他认为是尼罗河源头的地点
zh.s: 金奈尔德的詹姆斯·布鲁斯（1730年12月14日—1794年4月27日）是苏格兰旅行家和游记作家，实地确认了青尼罗河的源头。1770年，他在北非和东非旅行十余年后，成为首位沿尼罗河逆流而上，从埃及经苏丹至埃塞俄比亚青尼罗河源头追踪并记录河道的欧洲人。

en.s: Carleton's Raid was a raid led by British Major Christopher Carleton during the American War of Independence. It was launched in the fall 1778 from the Province of Quebec against targets in upstate Province of New York.

en.s: The Battle of James Island was a minor engagement on November 14, 1782, just outside Charleston, South Carolina, between American and British forces. British troops were on the move attempting to evacuate. In an effort to encourage the British evacuation, American forces led by Tadeusz Kościuszko attempted to ambush British troops under William Dansey who were cutting wood; however, reinforcements were quickly brought to the British side and Kościuszko's soldiers, numbering 70 men, were forced to retreat.

zh.s: 1782年11月14日，南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿郊外发生了一场美英小规模交战，史称詹姆斯岛战役。当时英军正准备撤离。为推动英军撤离，塔德乌什·柯斯丘什科率领的美军试图伏击威廉·丹西指挥、正在伐木的英军；但英军很快得到增援，柯斯丘什科的70名士兵被迫撤退。

en.s: The siege of Fort-Louis (14 October – 14 November 1793) saw a force composed of Habsburg Austrians, Hessians and Bavarians led by Franz von Lauer lay siege to Fort-Louis which was held by a Republican French garrison under Michel Durand. The French capitulated after a defense lasting exactly one month. The siege occurred during the War of the First Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars.

en.s: The Battle of Slobozia was fought between Russia and the Ottoman Empire as a part of the Napoleonic Wars during the Rusçuk–Slobozia operation within the Russo-Turkish War of 1806–1812. The primary battle occurred on the left bank of the Danube River near the small village of Slobozia in Wallachia. Four miles (6.4 km) to the southeast on the right bank of the Danube was the Ottoman fortress at Rusçuk.

en.s: At the Battle of Smoliani or Smolyany (N.S. November 13–14, 1812), the Russians under General Peter Wittgenstein defeated the French forces of Marshal Claude Victor and Marshal Nicholas Oudinot. This battle was the last effort of the French to reestablish their northern flank in Russia, known as the "Dvina Line". Previously, the French had been defeated in this sector at the Second Battle of Polotsk (October 18–20, 1812) and at the Battle of Czasniki (October 31, 1812).
en.n: Napoleonic Wars: At the Battle of Smoliani, French Marshals Victor and Oudinot are defeated by the Russians under General Peter Wittgenstein.

zh.s: 斯莫利亚尼战役又称斯莫良内战役，于1812年11月13日至14日爆发。彼得·维特根施泰因将军率领的俄军击败了克劳德·维克托元帅和尼古拉·乌迪诺元帅率领的法军。这是法军重建其在俄罗斯北翼“德维纳防线”的最后一次尝试。此前，法军已在该地区的波洛茨克第二次战役（1812年10月18日至20日）和恰斯尼基战役（1812年10月31日）中落败。

en.s: The Battle of Ayohuma ("dead man's head" in Quechua) was an action fought on 14 November 1813, during the second Upper Peru Campaign of the Argentine War of Independence. The republican forces of the Army of the North, led by General Manuel Belgrano were defeated by the royalists, commanded by Joaquín de la Pezuela.

zh.s: 阿约乌马在克丘亚语中意为“死者之首”。1813年11月14日，阿根廷独立战争的第二次上秘鲁战役期间，曼努埃尔·贝尔格拉诺将军率领的北方军共和派部队在阿约乌马战役中被华金·德拉佩苏埃拉指挥的保王党军击败。

en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 14, 1816 as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: A presidential election was held in North Carolina on November 14, 1816 as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. The Democratic-Republican ticket of U.S. secretary of state James Monroe and governor of New York Daniel D. Tompkins defeated the Federalist ticket. en.s: The second 1831 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 14. National Republican Governor Levi Lincoln Jr. was re-elected to an eighth term in office over Democrat Marcus Morton and Anti-Mason Samuel Lathrop. This was the first regular Massachusetts election scheduled for November after the schedule changed from April. This was also the first election featuring the organized involvement of the Anti-Masonic Party.

zh.s: 1831年第二次马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月14日举行。国民共和党州长利瓦伊·林肯二世再次当选，开始第八个任期，击败民主党候选人马库斯·莫顿和反共济会党候选人塞缪尔·拉斯罗普。这是马萨诸塞州选举时间从4月改到11月后的首次常规选举，也是反共济会党首次有组织地参与选举。

en.t: 1836 United States presidential election in Massachusetts
en.s: A presidential election was held in Massachusetts on November 14, 1836 as part of the 1836 United States presidential election. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: A presidential election was held in North Carolina on November 14, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. North Carolina voted for the Whig candidate, Henry Clay, over Democratic candidate James K. Polk. Clay won North Carolina by a margin of 4.63%.

zh.s: 作为1844年美国总统选举的一部分，北卡罗来纳州于1844年11月14日举行投票。选民选出11名总统和副总统选举人。北卡罗来纳州支持辉格党候选人亨利·克莱，击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克。克莱在北卡罗来纳州领先4.63个百分点。

en.s: Porongos Massacre or Porongos Betrayal was the penultimate confrontation of the Ragamuffin War (1835–1845) and occurred on 14 November 1844. The battle was primarily responsible for ending the longest of Brazil's revolutions. In November 1844, about a year before the end of the conflict, and with peace negotiations already underway, the more than 1,200 republicans, led by General David Canabarro, were surrounded and massacred in the unprotected countryside, due to Canabarro's negligence, according to some, or his treachery, according to others, by the more than 1,100 partisans who supported the Empire, led by Francisco Pedro de Abreu.

zh.s: 波龙戈斯大屠杀又称波龙戈斯背叛，是1835年至1845年巴西拉加马芬战争中的倒数第二场交战，发生于1844年11月14日。这场战斗是结束巴西持续时间最长的革命的主要原因。1844年11月，距离冲突结束约一年、和平谈判已经开始时，大卫·卡纳巴罗将军率领的1200多名共和派在没有防备的乡间遭到包围和屠杀。有人认为这是卡纳巴罗的失职所致，也有人认为是他背叛所致。屠杀者是弗朗西斯科·佩德罗·德·阿布雷乌率领的1100多名帝国派支持者。

en.t: Moby-Dick, a novel by Herman Melville, is published in the USA
en.s: Moby-Dick; or, The Whale is an 1851 epic novel by American writer Herman Melville. The book centers on the sailor Ishmael's narrative of the maniacal quest of Ahab, captain of the whaling ship Pequod, for vengeance against Moby Dick, the giant white sperm whale that bit off his leg on the ship's previous voyage.

zh.t: 赫尔曼·梅尔维尔的小说《白鲸》在美国出版
zh.s: 《白鲸》又名《白鲸记》，是美国作家赫尔曼·梅尔维尔于1851年创作的史诗小说。小说以水手以实玛利的叙述展开，讲述捕鲸船“裴廓德”号船长亚哈疯狂追捕白色巨型抹香鲸莫比·迪克以报断腿之仇的故事；莫比·迪克此前在船上一次航行中咬掉了他的腿。

en.t: The Joensuu City Hall, designed by Eliel Saarinen, was inaugurated in Joensuu, Finland
en.s: The Joensuu City Hall (Finnish: Joensuun kaupungintalo) is a brick building in the center of Joensuu, Finland, designed by Eliel Saarinen and completed in 1914, combining styles of Romantic Nationalism and late Art Nouveau. It serves as a center of culture and governance for the city. It houses the city's central administration, the city theater (the easternmost professional theater in the European Union) and a restaurant.

zh.t: 埃利尔·沙里宁设计的约恩苏市政厅在芬兰约恩苏举行落成仪式
zh.s: 约恩苏市政厅（芬兰语：Joensuun kaupungintalo）是芬兰约恩苏市中心的一座砖砌建筑，由埃利尔·沙里宁设计，于1914年完工，融合浪漫民族主义与晚期新艺术风格。它是该市文化和行政中心，设有市政府中央行政机构、城市剧院（欧盟最东端的职业剧院）和餐厅。

en.s: Conflicts took place in North Africa during World War I (1914–1918) between the Central Powers and the Entente and its allies. On 14 November 1914, the Ottoman Sultan proclaimed a jihad. en.s: The Communist Party of Spain (Spanish: Partido Comunista de España; PCE) is a political party in Spain that is part of the United Left coalition, which is currently also part of the electoral alliance Sumar. zh.s: 西班牙共产党（西班牙语：Partido Comunista de España，简称PCE）是西班牙政党，属于联合左翼联盟，目前也参加苏马尔选举联盟。佩德罗·桑切斯现任政府中有两名该党政治人物担任部长：劳动与社会经济大臣约兰达·迪亚斯，以及青年与儿童大臣西拉·雷戈。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 14 November 1925. All 75 seats in the House of Representatives, and 22 of the 36 seats in the Senate were up for election. The incumbent Nationalist Party of Australia led by Prime Minister of Australia Stanley Bruce in power since 1922 with coalition partner the Country Party led by Earle Page defeated the opposition Australian Labor Party led by Matthew Charlton. Compulsory voting for Federal elections was introduced in 1924 and first used in the 1925 elections where 91% of the electorate cast a vote.

en.s: The United Kingdom general election held on 14 November 1935 resulted in a large, though reduced, majority for the National Government now led by Conservative Stanley Baldwin. The greatest number of Members, as before, were Conservatives, while the National Liberal vote held steady. The National Labour vote collapsed, and even its leader Ramsay MacDonald lost his seat. Labour, under what was then regarded internally as the caretaker leadership of Clement Attlee following the resignation of George Lansbury slightly over a month before the election, made large gains over their very poor showing in the 1931 general election.

zh.s: 1935年11月14日举行的英国大选使斯坦利·鲍德温领导的国民政府继续以大幅但有所缩小的多数执政。保守党仍是议员人数最多的政党，国家自由党的得票保持稳定，国家工党的选票则大幅下滑，连其领袖拉姆齐·麦克唐纳也失去了议席。工党由克莱门特·艾德礼领导；乔治·兰斯伯里在选举前一个多月辞职后，党内当时把艾德礼视为看守领袖。工党较1931年大选惨败时取得了显著进展。

en.t: 1935 United Kingdom general election in Scotland
en.s: On Thursday 14 November 1935, the 1935 United Kingdom general election was held in Scotland, to elect all 615 members of the House of Commons, with 74 seats being in Scotland. 71 seats (32 burgh constituencies and 38 county constituencies) represented territorial constituencies. There was also one university constituency, which elected an additional 3 members using the Single Transferable Vote (STV) method.

zh.t: 1935年英国大选苏格兰地区选举
zh.s: 1935年11月14日星期四，英国举行大选，苏格兰选区参与选举下议院全部615个席位，其中74席来自苏格兰。苏格兰的71个席位属于地域选区，包括32个自治市选区和38个郡选区；另有1个大学选区，通过单记可转让投票制选出3名议员。

en.t: 1935 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland
en.s: The 1935 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland was held on 14 November as part of the wider general election. There were ten constituencies, seven single-seat constituencies with elected by FPTP and three two-seat constituencies with MPs elected by bloc voting.

zh.t: 1935年英国大选北爱尔兰地区选举
zh.s: 1935年11月14日，北爱尔兰举行英国大选地区选举，是英国大选的一部分。北爱尔兰有10个选区：7个单席选区采用简单多数制，3个双席选区采用集团投票制。

en.t: The Lions Gate Bridge, connecting Vancouver to the North Shore region, opens to traffic
en.s: The Lions Gate Bridge, opened in 1938 and officially known as the First Narrows Bridge, is a suspension bridge that crosses the first narrows of Burrard Inlet and connects the City of Vancouver, British Columbia, to the North Shore municipalities of the District of North Vancouver, the City of North Vancouver, and West Vancouver. The term "Lions Gate" refers to the Lions, a pair of mountain peaks north of Vancouver.

zh.t: 连接温哥华与北岸地区的狮门大桥通车
zh.s: 狮门大桥于1938年开通，正式名称为第一海峡桥，是一座横跨布拉德湾第一海峡的悬索桥，连接不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华市与北岸的北温哥华区、北温哥华市和西温哥华市。“狮门”一名指温哥华以北的一对山峰“狮子山”。

en.t: World War II: German troops, aided by local auxiliaries, murdered nine thousand residents of the Słonim Ghetto in a single day
en.s: The Słonim Ghetto (Polish: getto w Słonimiu; Belarusian: Слонімскае гета; German: Ghetto von Slonim; Yiddish: סלאָנים) was a Nazi German ghetto established in 1941 by the SS in Slonim, Western Belarus, German-occupied Poland during World War II. Prior to 1939, the town (Słonim) was part of the Second Polish Republic. The town was captured in late June 1941 by the Wehrmacht in the early stages of Operation Barbarossa.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：德国军队在当地辅助部队协助下，一天内屠杀斯洛尼姆隔都九千名居民
zh.s: 斯洛尼姆隔都（波兰语：getto w Słonimiu；白俄罗斯语：Слонімскае гета；德语：Ghetto von Slonim；意第绪语：סלאָנים）是纳粹德国于1941年在斯洛尼姆设立的隔都，地点位于二战期间德国占领的波兰西白俄罗斯地区。1939年前，斯洛尼姆属于波兰第二共和国。1941年6月下旬，德军在巴巴罗萨行动初期攻占该镇。

en.s: The Battle of the Coconut Grove was a battle between United States Marine Corps and Imperial Japanese Army forces on Bougainville Island during the Pacific War. The battle took place on 13–14 November 1943 during the Bougainville campaign, coming in the wake of a successful landing around Cape Torokina at the start of November, as part of the advance towards Rabaul as part of Operation Cartwheel.

en.s: The Bregalnitsa–Strumica operation (Bulgarian: Брегалнишко-Струмишка операция) was an offensive operation of Bulgarian Army during World War II in Yugoslav Macedonia. It was held by Fourth Bulgarian army from October 15 to November 14, 1944, and was aimed to secure the left flank of the First Bulgarian Army, blocking the way for retreat of the German group armies 'E' from Greece. The onslaught of the Army began on October 15.

zh.t: 布雷加尔尼察—斯特鲁米察行动
zh.s: 布雷加尔尼察—斯特鲁米察行动是第二次世界大战期间，保加利亚军队在南斯拉夫马其顿发动的进攻行动。第四保加利亚军团于1944年10月15日至11月14日实施该行动，目的是保障第一保加利亚军团的左翼，阻止德国E集团军群从希腊撤退。保加利亚军队于10月15日开始进攻。
zh.n: 本条记录采用来源资料框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Stracin–Kumanovo operation (Bulgarian: Страцинско-Кумановска операция) was an offensive operation conducted in 1944 by the Bulgarian Army against German forces in occupied Yugoslavia which culminated in the capture of Skopje in 1944. With the Bulgarian declaration of war on Germany on September 8, followed by the Bulgarian withdrawal from the area, the German 1st Mountain Division moved north, occupied Skopje, and secured the strategic Belgrade–Nis–Salonika railroad line.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 斯特拉钦—库马诺沃行动
zh.s: 1944年，保加利亚军队在被占领的南斯拉夫境内对德军发动斯特拉钦—库马诺沃行动，最终攻占斯科普里。保加利亚于9月8日对德国宣战并撤出该地区后，德国第一山地师向北移动，占领斯科普里，并控制了具有战略意义的贝尔格莱德—尼什—萨洛尼卡铁路。

en.t: The New Musical Express publishes the first regular UK Singles Chart
en.s: New Musical Express (NME) is a British music, film, gaming and culture website, and bimonthly magazine. Founded as a newspaper in 1952, with the publication being referred to as a "rock inkie", the NME would become a magazine that ended up as a free publication as well as a webzine, and the brand has also been used for their NME Awards show, the NME Tours and the former NME Radio station.

zh.t: 《新音乐快递》发布英国首张常规单曲排行榜
zh.s: 《新音乐快递》（NME）是英国音乐、电影、游戏和文化网站，也是一份双周刊杂志。它于1952年创办，最初作为报纸发行，被称为“摇滚油墨报”。后来NME转型为杂志，之后成为免费出版物和网络杂志；该品牌还用于NME颁奖礼、NME巡演及已停播的NME电台。

en.t: The "Apalachin meeting" in rural Tioga County in upstate New York is raided by law enforcement; many high-level Mafia figures are arrested while trying to flee
en.s: The Apalachin meeting ( AP-ə-LAY-kin) was a historic summit of the American Mafia held at the home of mobster Joseph "Joe the Barber" Barbara, at 625 McFall Road in Apalachin, New York, on November 14, 1957. Allegedly, the meeting was held to discuss various topics including loansharking, narcotics trafficking, and gambling, along with dividing the illegal operations controlled by the recently murdered Albert Anastasia.

zh.t: 纽约州北部蒂奥加县乡村地区的“阿帕拉钦会议”遭执法部门突袭，多名黑手党高层试图逃跑时被捕
zh.s: 阿帕拉钦会议是美国黑手党的一次历史性峰会，于1957年11月14日在纽约州阿帕拉钦举行，地点是黑帮人物约瑟夫·“理发师乔”·巴巴拉位于麦克福尔路625号的住所。据称，与会者讨论了高利贷、毒品交易和赌博等议题，也讨论如何瓜分近期被杀的阿尔伯特·阿纳斯塔西娅所控制的非法生意。

en.s: The campaign at the China–Burma border (simplified Chinese: 中缅边境作战; traditional Chinese: 中緬邊境作戰) was a series of battles fought along the China–Burma border after the Chinese Civil War, with the Communist People's Republic of China (PRC) and the Union of Burma on one side and the Nationalist forces of the Republic of China (ROC) on the other. The Chinese government refers to the campaign as the China–Burma border demarcation and security operation (中缅边境勘界警卫作战; 中緬邊境勘界警衛作戰).

en.s: The Elections for the House of Representatives of the Philippines were held on November 14, 1961. Held on the same day as the presidential election, the party of the incumbent president, Carlos P. Garcia's Nacionalista Party, won majority of the seats in the House of Representatives. However, Diosdado Macapagal of the opposition Liberal Party won the presidential election which led to majority of the elected Nacionalista congressman to switch sides to the Liberals. This led to Cornelio Villareal on being elected as Speaker of the House The elected representatives will serve in the 5th Congress from 1961 to 1965.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1961年11月14日举行众议院选举，与总统选举同日进行。现任总统卡洛斯·P·加西亚所属的国民党赢得众议院多数席位。不过，反对党自由党候选人迪奥斯达多·马卡帕加尔赢得总统选举，促使多数当选的国民党议员转投自由党。此后科尔内利奥·比利亚雷亚尔当选众议院议长。当选议员将在1961年至1965年间组成第五届国会。

en.s: A senatorial election was held on November 14, 1961 in the Philippines. The two candidates of the Progressive Party, guest candidates of the Liberal Party, topped the election, while the Liberals themselves won four seats cutting the Nacionalista Party's majority to 13 seats in the 24-seat Philippine Senate.

en.s: The 1962 Quebec general election was held on November 14, 1962, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Quebec, Canada. The incumbent Quebec Liberal Party, led by Jean Lesage, was re-elected, defeating the Union Nationale (UN) led by Daniel Johnson, Sr. In an unusual move, the election was called just two years after the previous 1960 general election.

en.s: The Battle of Ia Drang (Vietnamese: Trận Ia Đrăng, [iə̯ ɗrăŋ]; in English ) was the first major battle between the United States Army and the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN), as part of the Pleiku campaign conducted early in the Vietnam War, at the eastern foot of the Chu Pong Massif in the central highlands of Vietnam, in 1965.

en.s: A senatorial election were held on November 14, 1967 in the Philippines. The 1967 election for the members of the Philippine Senate were also known as the 1967 midterm election, as the date where the elected candidates take office falls halfway through President Ferdinand Marcos' four-year term. The administration Nacionalista Party won five seats in the Philippine Senate while the Liberal Party won three seats; the Nacionalistas got the majority in the Senate after having twelve of the 24 seats in the Senate prior to the election.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1967年11月14日举行参议院选举。这次选举也称1967年中期选举，因为当选议员就职时，正好是费迪南德·马科斯四年总统任期的中点。执政国民党赢得5席，自由党赢得3席。选举前，国民党在参议院24席中占12席；选后该党取得多数。

en.t: 1967 Philippine House of Representatives special elections
en.s: Five special elections (known as "by-elections" elsewhere) to the House of Representatives of the Philippines, the lower house of the Congress of the Philippines, were held on November 14, 1967, along with the 1967 Philippine Senate election and the 1967 Philippine constitutional plebiscite. These were for vacancies in the 6th Congress of the Philippines; the winners were to serve the rest of the term, which had ended on December 30, 1969.

en.t: American physicist Theodore Maiman was given a patent for his ruby laser systems, the world's first laser
en.s: Theodore Harold Maiman (July 11, 1927 – May 5, 2007) was an American engineer and physicist who is widely credited with the invention of the laser. Maiman's laser led to the subsequent development of many other types of lasers. The laser was successfully fired on May 16, 1960. In a July 7, 1960, press conference in Manhattan, Maiman and his employer, Hughes Aircraft Company, announced the laser to the world.

zh.t: 美国物理学家西奥多·梅曼获得红宝石激光系统专利，这是世界上第一台激光器
zh.s: 西奥多·哈罗德·梅曼（1927年7月11日—2007年5月5日）是美国工程师和物理学家，普遍被认为是激光的发明者。梅曼的激光器推动了此后多种其他激光器的发展。该激光器于1960年5月16日成功发射。1960年7月7日，梅曼与雇主休斯飞机公司在曼哈顿举行新闻发布会，向世界宣布激光问世。

en.s: Apollo 12 was the sixth manned flight in the United States Apollo program and the second to land on the Moon (an H type mission). It was launched on November 14, 1969, from the Kennedy Space Center, Florida, four months after Apollo 11. Mission commander Charles "Pete" Conrad and Lunar Module Pilot Alan L. Bean performed just over one day and seven hours of lunar surface activity while Command Module Pilot Richard F. Gordon remained in lunar orbit. The landing site for the mission was located in the southeastern portion of the Ocean of Storms.

zh.s: 阿波罗12号是美国阿波罗计划的第六次载人飞行，也是第二次登月任务（H型任务）。飞船于1969年11月14日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射，距阿波罗11号发射4个月。任务指令长查尔斯·“皮特”·康拉德和登月舱驾驶员艾伦·L·宾在月面活动了约31小时；指令舱驾驶员理查德·F·戈登留在月球轨道。登月点位于风暴洋东南部。

en.s: Southern Airways Flight 932 was a chartered Southern Airways twin engine McDonnell Douglas DC-9-30 domestic United States commercial jet flight from Stallings Field (ISO) in Kinston, North Carolina, to Huntington Tri-State Airport/Milton J. Ferguson Field (HTS) near Kenova and Ceredo, West Virginia. At 7:36 pm on November 14, 1970, the aircraft crashed into a hill just short of the Tri-State Airport, killing all 75 people on board – 37 members of the Marshall University football team, 5 coaches, 7 staff members, 21 boosters, 2 pilots, 2 flight attendants, and a charter coordinator.

zh.s: 南方航空932号班机是一架包租的双引擎麦道DC-9-30美国国内航班，原定从北卡罗来纳州金斯顿的斯托林斯机场飞往亨廷顿三州机场／米尔顿·J·弗格森机场，机场位于西弗吉尼亚州肯诺瓦和塞雷多附近。1970年11月14日19时36分，飞机在三州机场前撞上山坡，机上75人全部遇难，包括马歇尔大学橄榄球队37人、教练5人、工作人员7人、支持者21人、飞行员2人、空乘2人和一名包机协调员。

en.s: The Athens Polytechnic uprising occurred in November 1973 as a massive student demonstration of popular rejection of the Greek military junta of 1967–1974. It began on 14 November 1973, escalated to an open anti-junta revolt, and ended in bloodshed in the early morning of 17 November after a series of events starting with a tank crashing through the gates of the Athens Polytechnic.

en.s: The 1998 Progressive Conservative leadership election was held on October 24 and November 14, 1998 to choose a successor to Jean Charest. This was the first time the Progressive Conservatives used a one member, one vote system to choose a leader rather than a delegated leadership convention, which has been the norm since 1927. The 1998 election used a point system that allocated 100 points to each riding, regardless of the number of votes cast in the riding. The candidate who won a majority of points (not necessarily a majority of voters) would win the leadership.

The main match on the Raw brand was a 4 on 4 Survivor Series match, a type of elimination match, between Team Orton (Randy Orton, Chris Benoit, Chris Jericho, and Maven) and Team Triple H (Triple H, Edge, Batista, and Snitsky), which Team Orton won after Orton last eliminated Triple H.

en.t: 18th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
en.s: The 18th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party was held in the Great Hall of the People, Beijing from 8 to 14 November 2012. The National Congress is the highest organ of the party, and is stipulated to be held every five years. The conference had 2,268 delegates. The CCP Congress endorsed the amendments to the CCP constitution, membership list of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and elected the 18th Central Committee of the CCP.

en.s: The 2014 U.S. Virgin Islands gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 2014, to elect the governor of the United States Virgin Islands. Since no candidate received a majority in the general election, as required by the Revised Organic Act of the Virgin Islands, a runoff was held between Donna Christian-Christensen and Kenneth Mapp, the two top vote receivers.

en.s: The 2016 Kaikōura earthquake was a Mw 7.8 earthquake in the South Island of New Zealand that occurred two minutes after midnight on 14 November 2016 NZDT (11:02 on 13 November UTC). Ruptures occurred on multiple faults and the earthquake has been described as the "most complex earthquake ever studied". It has been subsequently modelled as having a megathrust component set off by an adjacent rupture on the Humps Fault.

en.s: The 2020 Norfolk Island local election was scheduled to be held on 14 November 2020 to elect the Norfolk Island Regional Council, the local government body of Norfolk Island. It was later postponed until March 2021, however the council was suspended in February 2021 and eventually dismissed later that year. The election was to have been conducted by the Australian Election Company.

zh.s: 2020年诺福克岛地方选举原定于11月14日举行，以选出诺福克岛地区委员会成员，后来推迟到2021年3月。该委员会于2021年2月被暂停运作，并在同年晚些时候解散。投票原由澳大利亚选举公司负责。

en.s: On November 14, 2021, jihadists from Ansarul Islam and Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin attacked the mining town of Inata, Burkina Faso, the last place in Djibo Department under Burkinabe government control at the time of the attack. The Burkinabe outpost in Inata was overrun and over fifty soldiers were killed.

zh.s: 2021年11月14日，伊斯兰支持者组织和伊斯兰与穆斯林支持者组织的武装分子袭击了布基纳法索矿业城镇伊纳塔。当时，伊纳塔是杰博省最后一个由政府控制的地方。武装分子攻占了伊纳塔的政府前哨据点，造成50多名士兵死亡。

en.s: The 2021 Hiroshima gubernatorial election (Japanese: 2021年広島県知事選挙) was held to elect the Governor of Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan, on 14 November 2021. Hidehiko Yuzaki, incumbent since 2009, was eligible to run and won re-election with nearly 90% of votes.

zh.s: 日本于2021年11月14日举行广岛县知事选举。自2009年起担任知事的汤崎英彦符合竞选资格，并以近90%的得票率连任。

en.s: The 2023 Northwest Territories general election was held on November 14, 2023. Nineteen members were elected to the 20th Northwest Territories Legislative Assembly. The Assembly is run on a consensus government system, in which all MLAs sit as independents and are not organized into political parties.

zh.s: 2023年11月14日，西北地区举行大选，选出第20届西北地区立法议会的19名议员。议会实行共识政府制度，所有议员以独立人士身份就职，不按政党组织。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Sri Lanka on 14 November 2024 to elect 225 members to the new parliament. The 16th Parliament of Sri Lanka was dissolved on 24 September 2024. The submission of nominations for the election commenced on 4 October and concluded on 11 October 2024 at 12:00. The result of the election was a landslide victory for the left-wing National People's Power coalition led by recently elected president Anura Kumara Dissanayake.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡于2024年11月14日举行议会选举，选出新一届议会的225名议员。第十六届议会于2024年9月24日解散。选举提名于10月4日开始，并于10月11日12时结束。新当选总统阿努拉·库马拉·迪萨纳亚克领导的左翼国家人民力量联盟大获全胜。
